text: I have not supplied proof under the doctrine of estoppel by silence, Englehardt vs. Gravens ( mo ) 281 SW 715,719, I presume that no proof of the alleged debt, nor therefore any such debt, in fact therefore exists. I am writing to dispute the validity of the collection account associated with [ Account Number ] on my credit report. I recently obtained a copy of my credit report and noticed the presence of this account, which I believe has inaccuracies. Upon reviewing the details of the account, I have identified discrepancies in the information provided. I request that you investigate and verify the accuracy of the following points : 1. **Validation of Debt : ** Please provide detailed documentation verifying the legitimacy of the debt, including the original creditor 's name, the original account number, and the complete chain of ownership. 2. **Statute of Limitations : ** Verify and confirm whether the debt falls within the statute of limitations for collections in [ State ]. If the statute of limitations has expired, the debt should no longer be legally collectible. 3. **Reporting Dates : ** Ensure that the reporting dates on my credit report align accurately with the actual timeline of this debt. Any inaccuracies in reporting dates may be grounds for removal. I am exercising my rights under the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act ( FDCPA ) and the Fair Credit Reporting Act ( FCRA ) to dispute this information. I kindly request that you provide a written response within 30 days of receiving this letter. If you can not validate the debt or if any inaccuracies are found, I request the immediate removal of this collection account from my credit report. Additionally, please provide written confirmation of the resolution and any actions taken. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. I look forward to a timely and positive resolution. Sincerely,
